verdict.rationale: Reflect's only headless automation path is its first-party REST API. It uses OAuth2/PKCE and bearer-token curl access, with documented endpoints to append to daily notes, create notes, and list or add links, so a script or CI job can drive part of the product without the UI. However, the API cannot serve note contents because of end-to-end encryption, and deep links require the app, so automation is largely write-only. Missing for 10: a CLI or headless runtime, any CI/automation guidance, read access to note contents, a sandbox/test environment, versioning policy, and hands-on corroboration.
